name: Dialog
intent: Interrupts the user to make a decision or complete a short, focused task without leaving the page: confirm a destructive action, fill a small form. Blocks the page until closed. Contains a title, an optional description, optional content such as TextFields, and Buttons as actions.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called on close button, Escape or backdrop click.

props.name: title
props.description: What the dialog is about; also its accessible name. Phrase confirmations as a question: "Delete project?".

props.name: description
props.description: One or two sentences explaining the consequence. Read by screen readers.

props.name: children
props.description: Extra content such as a short form.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons, right-aligned. Cancel first, confirming action last.

props.name: size
props.description: sm for confirmations, md for forms, lg for rich content.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Allow Escape, backdrop click and the close button. Turn off only while an action is in progress.

when: Confirming a destructive or irreversible action.
A short task (1–4 fields) that should not navigate away.
Critical information the user must acknowledge.

whenNot.situation: Status messages and confirmations of success
Content the user wants to compare with the page
whenNot.useInstead: A side drawer or inline Card

composition: Actions: <Button variant="outline">Cancel</Button> then the confirming Button.
Destructive confirmation: confirming Button uses color="danger" and repeats the verb ("Delete"), never "OK".
Never open a Dialog from inside another Dialog.
While saving, set loading on the confirm Button and dismissible={false}.

accessibility.role: dialog (aria-modal), named by the title and described by the description
keyboard: Focus moves into the dialog when it opens and returns to the trigger when it closes
Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside the dialog
notes: The close button has the accessible name "Close".

examples.title: Destructive confirmation
examples.code:
<Dialog
  open={open}
  onClose={close}
  title="Delete project?"
  description="This removes the project and its files for everyone. You can't undo this."
  actions={<>
    <Button variant="outline" onClick={close}>Cancel</Button>
    <Button color="danger" onClick={remove}>Delete</Button>
  </>}
/>

examples.title: Short form
examples.code:
<Dialog open={open} onClose={close} title="Invite teammate" size="md" actions={<Button onClick={invite}>Send invite</Button>}>
  <TextField label="Email" type="email" />
</Dialog>
